item.title: WATCH: Woman living the 'dream' to save Arctic foxes in need
item.description: ABC News' Danny New talks to a woman who's on a mission to save Arctic foxes at a sanctuary in upstate New York.

item.title: Trump says Iran war at "status quo," warns U.S. "locked and loaded"
item.description: President Trump told 60 Minutes the war with Iran was a "good decision" in the long term, despite its short-term impact.

item.title: Gas prices slip below $4 a gallon for first time since July
item.description: Petroleum expert Patrick De Haan predicts prices will continue to sink and reach $3.75 a gallon by Thanksgiving.
